name: ExportOAS

parameters.help_en: The APIs that you want to export
parameters.name: api_id_list

parameters.help_en:
The environment to which the API is published. Valid values:

RELEASE: the production environment

PRE: the pre-release environment

TEST: the test environment
parameters.help_zh:
API已发布的环境：

RELEASE：线上
PRE：预发
TEST：测试
parameters.name: stage_name

parameters.help_en:
The OAS version. Valid values:

oas2

oas3
parameters.name: oas_version

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to export API Gateway extensions at the same time
parameters.help_zh: 是否导出API网关拓展定义
parameters.name: with_x_extensions

parameters.help_en: The number of pages in which you want to export the APIs
parameters.help_zh: 导出分组下所有API时的分页页码
parameters.name: page_number

Data.description_en: The Base64-encoded data of the exported Swagger file. You can obtain the file by using Base64 decoding
